Energy and Utilities Finance and Policy Committee
Thursday, March 10, 2022
3:00 PMLivestream YouTube

Minutes
Present: Senator David H. Senjem - Chair, Senator Andrew Mathews - Vice Chair, Senator Roger C. Chamberlain, Senator Nick A. Frentz, Senator Jerry Newton, Senator Jason Rarick, Senator Patricia Torres Ray, Senator Paul J. Utke

Absent: No Members Absent
Senator David H. Senjem called the meeting to order at 3:05 PM

S.F. 3661: Senator Benson: State policy supporting the deployment of carbon capture and sequestration technologies establishment.

Agenda:  
1. S.F. 3661 Benson State policy supporting the deployment of carbon capture and sequestration technologies establishment.
  • SCS Presentation Materials_Minnesota_20220120CBH (PDF)
  • MREA support for SF 3661 March 9 2022 (PDF)
  • KCC - MNsentateEnergyCommittee 10Mar22_FINAL (PDF)
  • Carbon capture bill 03.10.22 (PDF)
  • Testimony for SF 3661 - Carbon Capture (PDF)
  • SF3661 LEC Testimony 3-10-22 (PDF)
  • Kevin Connors, Assistant Director for Regulatory Compliance and Energy Policy, Energy and Environment Research Center – University of North Dakota
  • Harvey Thorleifson, Director, Minnesota Geological Survey, Department of Earth and Environmental Sciences, University of Minnesota
  • Chris Hill, Director of Environmental and Permitting, Summit Carbon Solutions
  • Jake Ketzner, VP of Govt & Public Affairs, Summit Carbon Solutions
  • Sarah Mooradian, Government Relations and Policy Director, Clean Up the River Environment

DATE: March 10, 2022

Subcommittee on Property Taxes
Wednesday, March 30, 2022
8:30 AM, Room G-15, Capitol

Minutes
Present: Senator Bill Weber - Chair, Senator Roger C. Chamberlain - Vice Chair, Senator Matt D. Klein, Senator Erin P. Murphy

Absent: Senator John R. Jasinski
Senator Bill Weber called the meeting to order at 8:33am

S.F. 3289: Senator Dahms: Morton 2021 aid penalty forgiveness provision and appropriation.

Senator Dahms Presented S.F. 3289

  • Pam Ring – City Clerk of Morton – Testified

Senator Klein moved that S.F. 3289, be laid over.

S.F. 2788: Senator Dahms: Echo aid penalty forgiveness and appropriation.

Senator Dahms Presented S.F. 2788

        Ray Sweetman – Mayor of Echo - Testified 


Senator Murphy moved that S.F. 2788, be laid over.

S.F. 4021: Senator Howe: Disabled veterans\' homestead market value exclusion spousal benefit modification.

Senator Howe presented S.F. 4021

Senator Klein Moves A1 Amendment

  • Motion prevailed

Discussion


Senator Klein moved that S.F. 4021, as amended, be laid over.

S.F. 3200: Senator Bakk: Affordable housing market value exclusion establishment.

Senator Bakk presented S.F. 3200

  • Discussion over A2 amendment

Senator Murphy Moves A2 amendment

  • Motion prevailed

Testifiers:

Kelly Doran – Doran Properties Group – Testified


Senator Murphy moved that S.F. 3200, as amended, be laid over.

S.F. 3882: Senator Weber: Levy limits for certain cities.

Senator Weber presents S.F. 3882

  • Cecil Smith – MN Multi Housing Association – Testified
  • Joe Abraham – Pergola Management – Testified
  • Paul Eger – Senior Vice President Governmental Affairs – Testified
  • Dayna Kennedy – Resident – Testified
  • Mary Kay Capecchi – St. Paul resident – Testified
  • Dan Quillin – Leader of ISAIAH – Testified
  • Ginny Deluca – St. Paul resident – Testified

Discussion

Senator Klein requested Roll call to refer S.F. 3882 to Local Government 

  • Senator Weber voted no
  • Senator Murphy voted yes
  • Senator Klein voted yes
  • Senator Chamberlain voted no

2-2 Motion did not prevail 

Discussion

 


Senator Weber moved that S.F. 3882, be laid over.
The meeting was adjourned at 9:53am


 
                                                                      
Senator Bill Weber, Chair 		                                                                      
Lamont Pyykkonen, Legislative Assistant
